sources.observation: Three deep vaults break the dark coursed masonry. The center opening is larger than the side openings.
The single barrel vault is framed by large weathered ashlar blocks with a low open crest.

limitations: The gate footprints and road alignments come from the map. Heights, individual block joints and the lengths of the short adjoining curtain walls are approximate.
The surviving stone forms are modeled. The unoccupied site interior remains in the host, and the terrain datum is sampled at each gate approach.
